Samira: Midday wave: planning a 12:30 UTC deploy for models-api (v3.2.1). Need a smoke owner and a rollback standby. Who's available?
cheng: I can own smoke at 12:30. I'll run the smoke script and post results.
max: I'll be rollback standby. I have the rollback branch ready and will keep terminal open. Ping me if we need revert.
irene: Heads up I'm on the 13:00 DB migration, can't take smoke. @cheng please coordinate DB schema checks before cut.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy 'models-api v3.2.1' at 12:30 UTC into staging -> canary -> prod. CI: green. See runbook: https://rwd.internal/runbooks/models-api-deploy
cheng: Smoke checklist: 1) curl -sS https://staging.models.internal/health | jq .status (expect "ok")  2) run sample gen: POST https://staging.models.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"quick check"}'  3) verify p95 latency < 120ms. I'll paste commands if anyone wants to copy.
max: Rollback steps I'll follow if needed: `git checkout rollback/models-api-3.2.0 && ./deploy.sh --target=prod --strategy=bluegreen` Keep watch on error_rate > 2% to trigger.
Samira: Thanks. @max @cheng please confirm you both will be on call at 12:25 UTC and mark :smoke-done: emoji when finished.
cheng: Confirmed. I'll post smoke results and any anomalies.
max: Confirmed. I'll standby on #eng-oncall and will execute rollback if triggered.
Samira: Great — linking preflight checklist: https://rwd.internal/checklists/deploy-preflight.md :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled in 5 minutes for 'models-api v3.2.1' deploy.
Samira: If anything changes, edit the runbook or ping here. Otherwise proceeding with the 12:30 window. :rocket:
